s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and neurological symptoms with multi-organ involvement and a possible malignant process
salient_findings: Multiple pulmonary nodules and pleural effusion
Left adrenal mass and pelvic mass
key_facts: Diffuse crackles in the upper and lower lung fields
Markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase of 2764 U/L
Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve
Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on core-needle biopsy of pelvic mass

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and neurological symptoms with multi-organ involvement and a possible malignant process
salient_findings: Multiple pulmonary nodules and pleural effusion
Left adrenal mass and pelvic mass
key_facts: Diffuse crackles in the upper and lower lung fields
Markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase of 2764 U/L
Right atrial mass with prolapse across tricuspid valve
Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on core-needle biopsy of pelvic mass

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and multi-organ involvement

shortlist.label: Choriocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Highly elevated lactate dehydrogenase and metastatic disease

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces and aggressive clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Pulmonary lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory symptoms and malignant cells on biopsy

shortlist.label: Metastatic adrenal cortical carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large adrenal mass and metastatic disease

raw.rationale: Malignant cells lining vascular spaces on biopsy, marked elevation of lactate dehydrogenase, and presence of multiple systemic masses and nodules are consistent with intravascular lymphoma, a rare and aggressive lymphoma that can present with widespread disease and multi-organ involvement.

rejected.label: Choriocarcinoma
rejected.why: Typically associated with pregnancy or testicular cancer, which is not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: While it could explain some vascular findings, the biopsy results and clinical presentation are more suggestive of lymphoma

rejected.label: Pulmonary lymphoma
rejected.why: Does not fully account for the extrapulmonary masses and systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Metastatic adrenal cortical carcinoma
rejected.why: Does not explain the malignant cells lining vascular spaces or the marked elevation of lactate dehydrogenase
